name: @ujg/colors
description: UJG Color System — the reference sheet plus drop-in token files for web, react, next.js and expo.

scripts.build: node ujg-color-system/scripts/extract.mjs ujg_color_system_v2_1.html ujg-color-system/ujg-colors.json && node ujg-color-system/scripts/generate.mjs ujg-color-system/ujg-colors.json ujg-color-system
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2020 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler ujg-color-system/react/ujgColors.ts ujg-color-system/nextjs/ujgColors.ts ujg-color-system/expo/ujgColors.ts ujg-color-system/expo/theme.ts
